text: With the focus of the Clan, blackberry clusters, horsetail clumps, mullein, goldenrod, raspberry clusters, oak leaf bundles, wild garlic, elder leaf bundles, ragwort, plantain bundles, marigold, cobwebs, tansy, thyme bundles, burdock roots, doses of poppy seeds, daisies, dandelions, juniper bunches, and betony were gathered.
During the Gathering, Yewstar remarks that CougarClan's apprentices seem to be growing into fine young cats. (CougarClan relations improved.)
Despite a long search, Pigment could not be found by the Clan.
Yewstar sees a glimmer of determination in Molekit's eyes. (low positive effect)
After the Gathering, Yewstar notices that Pearpelt is making sure everyone got home. (low positive effect)
Prancelaurel wishes Blotchkit would take things more seriously. (medium negative effect)
Prancelaurel is delighted to be working with Gardeniaglow today. (medium positive effect)
Prancelaurel purrs for a long time at one of Fluttershade's lame jokes. (high positive effect)
In the nursery, Craneflight lies suckling a single kitten, Erminedaisy watching over them and purring so hard his body vibrates.
Craneflight and Heatherfern perk up happily when they see each other. (medium positive effect)
Craneflight listens to Curryfoot's big plans for the day. (low positive effect)
Primfreckle won't take Silkykit seriously. (medium negative effect)
Primfreckle can't help but smile seeing Dahliacrest smile. (low positive effect)
Primfreckle is sick with whitecough.
Peatcrest can't help but feel uneased at Shimmerrunner's words lately. (low negative effect)
Peatcrest convinces Brinerump to help him pull a prank on a Clanmate. (medium positive effect)
Carptail finds a bit of fluff that smells like Primfreckle and adds it to his nest. (low positive effect)
Late into the evening, Carptail invites Bouncepelt, Mallardfeather, Stoatshade, and Cobaltstrike to stretch with him and enjoy each other's company. (positive effect)
Yewstar's good morning to Carptail meant a lot to him. (low positive effect)
Saffronfoot asks Frondpad to teach him how to sing so well. (medium positive effect)
Saffronfoot is proud to be in the same Clan as Snippool. (high positive effect)
Oddmuzzle is prancing around in front of Dancingscreech. (low positive effect)
Oddmuzzle and Algaepool always challenge one another. (high positive effect)
Despite Hollyheart being a bit dramatic about the thorn in his paw, Oddmuzzle treats him gently. (medium positive effect)
Hollyheart is amazed at how skilled Gardeniaglow really is. (high positive effect)
Heavythud gives Pestofoot a circular Twoleg object he found, and hides behind his whiskers when thanked. (high positive effect)
Heavythud feels extremely unsettled when Pheasantbrush looks at him. (high negative effect)
Flutterfeather tries to do something like Peakspore but ends up embarrassing himself. (medium negative effect)
Flutterfeather spends some time sheltering with Talonlake during a storm. (medium positive effect)
Saltknoll turned to Bouncepelt in a time of need, only for Bouncepelt to abandon him. (high negative effect)
Saltknoll feels safe with Pestofoot around. (high positive effect)

Olivebranch and Mosscrackle were so busy worrying about and looking forward to the birth that it's only now that they look at their litter of 2 kits that they wonder what to name them. Later, as the medicine cat wails with Olivebranch's blood streaked through their pelt and a warrior comes to move the body for the vigil, no one knows what to do with the litter of 2 kits.
Curryfoot wonders why Heavythud is so pouty today. (low negative effect)
Curryfoot had a disagreement with Petalglow about something or other. (low negative effect)
Tomatofreckle thinks about how Wasppaw is always reliable. (medium positive effect)
An issue becomes benign when Tomatofreckle remembers Kamautail's advice. (medium positive effect)
Kamautail appreciates Nightglow telling him that he had a feather stuck to his face. (low positive effect)
Kamautail prevents something from falling on Bushberry. (low positive effect)
During rough weather, Pestofoot helps Stoatshade get safely to his den. (medium positive effect)
Stoatshade confesses to Peatcrest that he has feelings for Yewstar. (positive effect)
Stoatshade didn't know that Bushberry was so talented. (medium positive effect)
Ochretail is looking out for Snookpaw's well-being. (medium positive effect)
Ochretail and Quailfur talk about what they see in the clouds. (low positive effect)
Ochretail wasn't looking where he was going and tripped over a small stump, gaining a few bruises.
After Algaepool tidies up an area, Frondpad accidentally messes it up again. (low negative effect)
The moon casts a shadow on Heatherfern's face in a way that makes Algaepool uneasy. (medium negative effect)
Auburnsplash knows that Swallowkit fake-laughed at her joke. (medium negative effect)
When Auburnsplash panics about something, she thinks of Fidgetmouse to feel better. (high positive effect)
Lightpelt noticed that Primfreckle wasn't in her nest last night. (low negative effect)
Lightpelt and Kiwifoot heckled another Clan at the Gathering together. (high positive effect)
After Warmswirl's claw-wound healed, he now has damaged throat.
Warmswirl notices that Hushshimmer brought him a big piece of prey. (medium positive effect)
When tucking in for the night, Warmswirl saw that Frondpad fixed his nest. (low positive effect)
Amberfur thinks that Auburnsplash is very creative. (medium positive effect)
Amberfur laughs at bad jokes from Skulkwillow. (medium positive effect)
Fringesnap doesn't see why Diablofoot is upset about something trivial. (low negative effect)
Fringesnap complains about something Freezefoot did. (low negative effect)
Pebblechase appreciates Carptail telling him that he had a feather stuck to his face. (low positive effect)
Nightglow hit Pebblechase on the face with his tail while passing by. (low negative effect)
Saffronfoot flicked some sand over Heatherfern's fresh-kill while she was eating. (medium negative effect)
Fidgetmouse tells Heatherfern that her pelt is shiny today. (low positive effect)
Fidgetmouse overhears Peakspore saying something nice about her. (high positive effect)
Fidgetmouse returned to the warrior's den dripping mud everywhere and managed to ruin Bitterleaf and Icyriver's nests. (negative effect)
Fidgetmouse notices one of her friends laughing with Nightglow. (low negative effect)
Archbellow and Blotchkit enjoy each other's company. (high positive effect)
Bouncepelt knows secrets about Archbellow that he hasn't told anyone else. (high positive effect)
Nightglow sees Saffronfoot neglect a Clanmate. (high negative effect)
Nightglow isn't impressed with Kamautail's work lately. (low negative effect)
Nightglow saved Mallardfeather from a fox but was hurt.
Cobaltstrike thought Molekit was polite today. (low positive effect)
Ochretail compliments Cobaltstrike's name. (low positive effect)
Cobaltstrike's tail was badly injured by a dog.
With her single kitten mewling at her belly, Mallardfeather's long pregnancy has finally given her and Burrweb the expansion to their family they've been hoping and waiting for.
Mallardfeather is disappointed when Silkykit doesn't uphold a promise. (medium negative effect)
Mallardfeather doesn't think that Diablofoot has been completely honest lately. (low negative effect)
Pigeonbloom saw Murkhaven hide something before talking to them. (low negative effect)
Pigeonbloom is sharing the latest gossip they heard over the border with Pearpelt. (medium positive effect)
The bite wound feels hot — Blizzardstripe winces as Heavythud cleans it. It's becoming infected.
Blizzardstripe and Nightglow spend a few minutes complimenting one another. (high positive effect)
Blizzardstripe sees the blood of fresh-kill on Fluttershade's paws and feels a prickle of discomfort. (low negative effect)
Snakedrop makes a small sacrifice that benefits Bitterleaf. (low positive effect)
Both Bitterleaf and Quailfur avoid one another's eye contact. (low negative effect)
When tucking in for the night, Harefeather saw that Burrweb fixed his nest. (low positive effect)
Harefeather complained so relentlessly about his patrol assignment that Fidgetmouse, Cobaltstrike, Pearpelt, and Fluttershade could only sigh and bear it. (negative effect)
Harefeather asks to be on a patrol with Bitebone. (medium positive effect)
Paellapad is no longer suffering from tick fever.
Paellapad hears Peatcrest laugh at a Clanmate's joke even though it was lame. (low positive effect)
Paellapad doesn't tell Freezefoot that she forgot to groom a part of her fur. (low negative effect)
Ospreykit accidentally hurts Dancingscreech during an argument between them. (high negative effect)
Dancingscreech, Peatcrest, and Paellapad took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
Auburnsplash's name comes up in a heated conversation, and Dancingscreech is the first to stand up for her. (high positive effect)
Fluttershade often goes to Sardinespeckle for guidance. (high positive effect)
Fluttershade has had a great time hanging out with Paellapad lately. (high positive effect)
Gracklefur heard an ugly rumor about Midnightkit. (high negative effect)
Gracklefur quickly apologizes after bumping into Bitebone. They have a small laugh about it. (low positive effect)
Peakspore smells something strange on Piperkit. (low negative effect)
Peakspore, Shardtail, and Gardeniaglow took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
Peakspore thinks Pigeonbloom is really funny. (low positive effect)
Wasppaw guides Bitebone to someone he is looking for. (low positive effect)
Brinerump accidentally hurts Bitebone during an argument between them. (high negative effect)
Bouncepelt finds out something small about Freezefoot that Freezefoot had lied about before. (low negative effect)
Paellapad gives Bouncepelt something that he dropped. (low positive effect)
Burrweb had a difficult conversation with Skulkwillow and they now have a deeper understanding of each other. (high positive effect)
Burrweb spends the Gathering whispering to Quailfur, Mallardfeather, Harefeather, and Pigeonbloom, making it nearly impossible for anyone nearby to hear the leaders speak. (negative effect)
Burrweb greets Snippool as she's exiting the warriors' den. (medium positive effect)
Suntooth feels a little safer when Craneflight joins her in the clearing. (low positive effect)
Suntooth and Shardtail enjoy the rain together. (low positive effect)
Pearpelt is feeling much better. They've recovered from the heat stroke.
Pearpelt is impressed by some of Mallowpelt's advice. (medium positive effect)
Pearpelt and Blizzardstripe take a nap together. (low positive effect)
Nightglow gives Quailfur something that he dropped. (low positive effect)
Quailfur is talking with Warmswirl. (low positive effect)
Diablofoot and Pigeonbloom make each other laugh. (low positive effect)
Peatcrest's good morning to Diablofoot meant a lot to her. (low positive effect)
Reedheart pads along on all four legs for the first time in a long time, wincing. His healed broken bone has definitely left the leg weaker, but it's manageable as far as he's concerned.
Reedheart notices that things always go wrong when Peatcrest is around. (medium negative effect)
Reedheart and Suntooth reach for the same piece of prey and bicker over it. Suntooth gets it. (low negative effect)
Reedheart misstepped and slipped from a rock, spraining his paw.
After the Gathering, Brinerump notices that Peatcrest is making sure everyone got home. (low positive effect)
Brinerump wants to be closer to Shardtail. (low positive effect)
Dahliacrest can tell how brave Blotchkit is being about something important. (low positive effect)
Lightpelt doesn't entertain a rumor that is being spread about Dahliacrest. (medium positive effect)
Freezefoot was convinced that Skulkwillow was lying about something, but Skulkwillow wasn't. (medium negative effect)
Snookpaw respects Snippool's opinion despite disagreeing with it. (low positive effect)
Snippool is surprised by the hurtful things Icyriver can say in an argument. (medium negative effect)
Gardeniaglow asked Silkykit for his opinion on a topic and had a surprisingly insightful conversation. (high positive effect)
Gardeniaglow confesses something to Shinefur, but realizes she can't relate at all. (low negative effect)
Gorgekit sends a Clanmate to help Mossflight with something she's struggling with. (low positive effect)
Wasppaw, Shadowpaw, Antlerpaw, and Snookpaw wish that Mossflight let them sleep instead of getting them up for early morning stretches. (negative effect)
Mossflight is jealous that Fringesnap got to go to the last Gathering. (medium negative effect)
Hushshimmer has a weird feeling about something Brinerump said the other day. (low negative effect)
Hushshimmer smells something strange on Elmtrail. (low negative effect)
Shardtail appreciates Mallardfeather's helpful attitude. (low positive effect)
Shardtail swears that Fleadusk stole something from their nest. (high negative effect)
Tansykit compliments one of Kiwifoot's friends. (low positive effect)
Kiwifoot is frustrated after finishing a task that Poolleaf was supposed to do. (medium negative effect)
Verbenabloom thinks Shardtail was nice to her today. (low positive effect)
Verbenabloom, Fringesnap, and Fleadusk took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
Verbenabloom got tricked into doing one of Pestofoot's chores. (low negative effect)
Fleadusk thinks the prey Peakspore is biting into on the other side of camp looks delicious. (low negative effect)
Verbenabloom doesn't believe Fleadusk when he explains that a rumor about him is false. (high negative effect)
Skulkwillow realizes that a strange smell in camp is coming from Molekit. (medium negative effect)
Skulkwillow and Fleadusk enjoy the rain together. (low positive effect)
Piperkit keeps avoiding eye contact with Murkhaven. (medium negative effect)
Amberfur promises Murkhaven that everything will be okay. (medium positive effect)
Icyriver and Bitebone talk about what they see in the clouds. (low positive effect)
Icyriver, Brindletooth, and Hushshimmer took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
Icyriver and Sardinespeckle spend the morning telling interesting stories. (low positive effect)
Elmtrail doesn't like the way Ochretail interacts with a Clanmate. (low negative effect)
Elmtrail brings Heavythud a piece of fresh-kill after a long day of healing work. (medium positive effect)
Brindletooth is reevaluating how much they value Tansykit as a Clanmate. (high negative effect)
Sardinespeckle talks all the time about Midnightkit. (high positive effect)
Sardinespeckle helps Hushshimmer figure out how to word something. (medium positive effect)
Shinefur trusts Snakedrop with a very important task. (high positive effect)
Shinefur quickly apologizes after bumping into Hailfreckle. They have a small laugh about it. (low positive effect)
Talonlake saw Snakedrop hide something before talking to him. (low negative effect)
Elmtrail compliments one of Talonlake's friends. (low positive effect)
Frondpad chats with Saffronfoot while grabbing something to eat. (medium positive effect)
While Frondpad gorges on her piece of fresh kill, Fleadusk, Mallowpelt, and Pheasantbrush find that eating is suddenly less appealing. (negative effect)
Poolleaf thinks Frondpad is lying when she apologizes for something. (high negative effect)
Poolleaf daydreams about getting back at Murkhaven for wronging her. (medium negative effect)
Hailfreckle won't tell Poolleaf what's got him acting weird. (low negative effect)
Poolleaf was on a walk when she saw Gracklefur being attacked by a dog! She helped Gracklefur escape, but not before gaining a few wounds.
Archbellow snickered when Pheasantbrush tripped. (low negative effect)
Pheasantbrush tried to show off on a hunting patrol, but Elmtrail got all the attention instead. (medium negative effect)
Mallowpelt feels like Gardeniaglow wasn't listening to him. (low negative effect)
Mallowpelt keeps having bad dreams about Shimmerrunner. (high negative effect)
Onemuzzle finds the way Algaepool acts increasingly uncomfortable. (medium negative effect)
During the last gathering, Onemuzzle and Voletuft defended their Clan against another Clan's heckling. (medium positive effect)
Onemuzzle has a stomachache.
Reedheart makes a small sacrifice that benefits Pestofoot. (low positive effect)
It seems like there's an unspoken apology between Pestofoot and Dancingfleck. (medium positive effect)
Voletuft brushes against Murkhaven while correcting their stance and looks away with a purr. (medium positive effect)
Spittle and flecks of bone fly while Voletuft gobbles down prey, reminding Antlerpaw, Shadowpaw, Snookpaw, and Wasppaw to seek out better mealtime companionship next time. (negative effect)
Voletuft drops into the medicine den to ask Flutterfeather if he's eaten yet. (medium positive effect)
Flightsplash doesn't like the way Fidgetmouse interacts with a Clanmate. (low negative effect)
Flightsplash chats with Onemuzzle about their day. (medium positive effect)
Skiphare hears a nice story about Gardeniaglow. (low positive effect)
Skiphare doubts whether Gentleghost even likes him at all... (high negative effect)
Hailfreckle and Shadowpaw chat about Clan news. (low positive effect)
Hailfreckle thinks Gentleghost is trying to steal one of his friends! (high negative effect)
Shimmerrunner notices a strange glint in Verbenabloom's eyes. (low negative effect)
Shimmerrunner can tell how brave Voletuft is being about something important. (low positive effect)
While on guard duty, Shimmerrunner caught Wasppaw trying to sneak out of camp.
Rollshock has noticed Burrweb isn't doing a lot of work lately. (medium negative effect)
Rollshock and Pheasantbrush make each other laugh. (low positive effect)
Butterflykit makes a small sacrifice that benefits Dancingfleck. (low positive effect)
Snakedrop has recovered from his sprain.
Snakedrop is disappointed when Tansykit doesn't uphold a promise. (medium negative effect)
Snakedrop associates his favorite smell with Hailfreckle. (high positive effect)
Snakedrop overdid his last sparring session and sprained a paw.
Daisymoor doesn't think Carptail's weird joke was just a joke. (medium negative effect)
Daisymoor appreciates Flightsplash telling her that she had a feather stuck to her face. (low positive effect)
The whole Clan notices how close Gentleghost and Gorgekit are lately. (high positive effect)
Gentleghost is impressed by Dancingfleck helping others today. (low positive effect)
Antlerpaw's running nose is gone.
Antlerpaw hasn't managed to avoid whitecough, Heavythud tells him. The water he inhaled must have been carrying illness with it. He's confined to camp while he recovers.
Peatcrest pulled a prank on Antlerpaw. (medium negative effect)
Sardinespeckle yawns while Wasppaw is trying to tell her something. (low negative effect)
Cherrykit respects Wasppaw's opinion despite disagreeing with it. (low positive effect)
Snookpaw thinks Hailfreckle has been acting strangely. (low negative effect)
Snookpaw starts to see flaws in Piperkit's philosophies. (medium negative effect)
Shadowpaw wants to be closer to Primfreckle. (low positive effect)
Shadowpaw swears that Blotchkit stole something from his nest. (high negative effect)
Petalglow is disappointed in Algaepool's lack of initiative. (medium negative effect)
Petalglow wasn't going to help a Clanmate, but realized that Mosscrackle would do it in a heartbeat. (medium positive effect)
Mosscrackle asks Frondpad about something complicated and is amazed at how quickly Frondpad understands. (high positive effect)
Mosscrackle feels ignored by Craneflight. (low negative effect)
Mosscrackle has gotten whitecough.
Erminedaisy notices how closely Mallardfeather sticks to her beliefs. (medium positive effect)
Bushberry finds out something small about Skiphare that Skiphare had lied about before. (low negative effect)
Bushberry tracked a trail of muddy pawprints into the elder's den, straight through the nests of Erminedaisy and Petalglow. (negative effect)
Bushberry thinks Stoatshade is really funny. (low positive effect)
m_c will always love r_c, but has decided to move on.
As Blotchpaw touches noses with Dahliacrest, she hopes that she'll be a cool mentor that won't assign boring tasks. Anything but gathering moss or tick duty!
Blotchpaw shares a joke about a neighboring Clan with Stoatshade. (low positive effect)
Blotchpaw feels a little safer when Cherrykit joins her in the clearing. (low positive effect)
Wavepaw sits excitedly beside Pebblechase as the meeting ends and hopes he'll be doing something exciting like battle training first. His claws are itching to tear at something.
Wavepaw and Heatherfern come up with a catchy song together. (low positive effect)
Wavepaw offers to take Shadowpaw's place on a patrol when he isn't feeling well. (medium positive effect)
Wavepaw saved Voletuft from a big dog, but was badly injured.

As Cherrypaw touches noses with Gardeniaglow, she hopes she'll get to do something that will really impress the Clan on her first day. Maybe she could catch a big, fat rabbit? Or chase off a fox! That'll show the Clan she's the best apprentice anyone's ever seen!
Cherrypaw has snuggled up against Shimmerrunner. (medium positive effect)
Cherrypaw hears a nice story about Piperkit. (low positive effect)

As Piperpaw touches noses with Snippool, he hopes he'll get to do something that will really impress the Clan on his first day. Maybe he could catch a big, fat rabbit? Or chase off a fox! That'll show the Clan he's the best apprentice anyone's ever seen!
Piperpaw heard a story about something kind Fidgetmouse did. (low positive effect)
Piperpaw swore he saw Snookpaw burying something. (high negative effect)
The VoleClan medicine cat comes asking if RiverClan have any ragwort to spare. Graciously, the Clan decides to aid their allies and share the herbs.
Drizzlekit feels relieved at the lack of pain in her head. Her headache seems to have finally gone away.
Drizzlekit gets hit with waves of envy whenever Glowkit is laughing with friends. (high negative effect)
Drizzlekit and Currentkit enjoy the rain together. (low positive effect)
Currentkit and Yewstar say goodbye, but end up walking in the same direction. (low negative effect)
Currentkit can't wait to be apprentices with Gorgekit. (high positive effect)
Gorgekit is asking Primfreckle where kits come from. (medium positive effect)
Gorgekit feels a little safer when Drizzlekit joins her in the clearing. (low positive effect)
Tansykit has recovered from the heat exhaustion.
Murkhaven pulled an embarrassing prank on Tansykit's friend. (low negative effect)
Tansykit tried to have a friendly discussion with Gorgekit about what prey tastes best, but it turned into an argument. (medium negative effect)
Silkykit is taken aback by one of Archbellow's comments. (low negative effect)
Silkykit tells a story to Midnightkit and Midnightkit suggests how to make it even better. (medium positive effect)
Heavythud brings Butterflykit the biggest moss-ball ever! (medium positive effect)
Butterflykit has a discussion with Ospreykit over favorite prey, and now they both have a new appreciation for each others' tastes (medium positive effect)
Molekit is amazed at how skilled Voletuft really is. (high positive effect)
Molekit overhears Tansykit dispelling a false rumor about a Clanmate. (medium positive effect)
A Clanmate has to comfort Glowkit when Dancingfleck says something cruel. (high negative effect)
Glowkit learns that Gorgekit has been using him for something. (high negative effect)
Whiskerkit worries that one of his friends prefers Saltknoll. (medium negative effect)
Whiskerkit doesn't tell Ospreykit that she forgot to groom a part of her fur. (low negative effect)
Swallowkit realizes that a strange smell in camp is coming from Gorgekit. (medium negative effect)
Swallowkit argues with Currentkit in front of other cats and reveals something embarrassing. (high negative effect)
Poolleaf follows through on a small promise made with Carnationkit. (low positive effect)
Carnationkit is happy to run into Molekit today. (high positive effect)
Midnightkit managed to recover from his heat exhaustion.
Midnightkit and Antlerpaw splash each other in a puddle, but it doesn't look playful... (low negative effect)
Midnightkit's friend says nice things about Carnationkit, but it just makes Midnightkit jealous. (low negative effect)
Bravekit's heat exhaustion has abated.
Bravekit chomps on Erminedaisy's ear. (medium positive effect)
Ospreykit got lost and Fidgetmouse didn't look for her. (high negative effect)
Currentkit tells Ospreykit that her pelt is shiny today. (low positive effect)
Ospreykit snuck out of camp and returned scraped up, but brimming with pride despite the scolding she was given.
At Olivebranch's vigil, Pigeonbloom refuses to move, crying and snapping at anyone who gets too close. No one could possibly understand how they feel.

This past moon, m_c has taken {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} place in StarClan. c_n mourns the loss of their Clanmate, and {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates will miss where {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} had been in their lives. Moments of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} life are shared in stories around the circle of mourners as those that were closest to {PRONOUN/m_c/object} take {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} final resting place.
